serverInfo.name: channel-pilot-pro-mcp
serverInfo.title: Channel Pilot Pro MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Channel Pilot Pro, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which Product API feeds does our shop have, and is the last upload imported?"; "Update the price and stock of SKU MYARTICLE-1 in feed 7."; "Show what we sent for offsets 100 to 120 in feed 7.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Channel Pilot Pro data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run channelpilotpro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run channelpilotpro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run channelpilotpro_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. channelpilotpro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_list_feeds
tools.title: List Product API feeds
tools.description: List the Product API feeds of a Channel Pilot Pro shop, with each feed's feed_id and unique_article_identifier. Use this first to find the feed_id.

shop_id.description: Shop ID, from the shop in Channel Pilot Pro.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_get_feed_status
tools.title: Get feed status
tools.description: Get the status of a Product API feed: last_requested_offset (last upload) and last_imported_offset (last update available in Channel Pilot Pro), plus article_count.

feed_id.description: Feed ID, as returned by channelpilotpro_list_feeds.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_get_feed_data
tools.title: Read feed data by offset
tools.description: Read the product data a feed stored for an inclusive offset range. Use it to check what was sent. Data is kept for three days.

feed_id.description: Feed ID, as returned by channelpilotpro_list_feeds.

begin_offset.description: Offset of a product update in the feed.

end_offset.description: Offset of a product update in the feed.

tools.name: channelpilotpro_upsert_products
tools.title: Create or update products (PATCH)
tools.description: Create or update products in a feed. Only the fields you send change; missing products are created (operation PATCH_OR_CREATE). Repeating the same call gives the same result. Check the import with channelpilotpro_get_feed_status.

feed_id.description: Feed ID, as returned by channelpilotpro_list_feeds.

items.description: One product object. It must include the feed's unique article identifier (for example sku; see unique_article_identifier in channelpilotpro_list_feeds). Other keys are the product fields, for example price and stock.

products.description: Products to send in this call (at most 1000).

tools.name: channelpilotpro_delete_products
tools.title: Delete products
tools.description: Delete products from a feed (operation DELETE). Send only the identifier fields (for example sku) of each product. The products are removed from the shop data in Channel Pilot Pro.

feed_id.description: Feed ID, as returned by channelpilotpro_list_feeds.

items.description: One product object. It must include the feed's unique article identifier (for example sku; see unique_article_identifier in channelpilotpro_list_feeds). Other keys are the product fields, for example price and stock.

products.description: Products to send in this call (at most 1000).
